text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 74 units of etoposide with a daily use of 3, providing 25 days on hand. The product label (NDC 71288017625) names Kindos Pharmaceuticals Co. as the manufacturing plant, but the plant is not placed in FDA records.

Why (FDA record): As of 2026-10-21, etoposide is not listed on the FDA drug shortage list.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 25 days. No FDA shortage listing exists. The manufacturing plant for our current NDC is not verifiable in FDA records. Five alternative suppliers are available, none of which appear on the FDA shortage list, though their manufacturing plants are also not placed in FDA records.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and qualify AVYXA Pharma, LLC as an alternative source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Accord Healthcare Inc. as an alternative source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate and qualify BluePoint Laboratories as an alternative source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as an alternative source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
5. Buyer to evaluate and qualify H2-Pharma, LLC as an alternative source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
